body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: up to 6 Cursor specialists in parallel (plan-fidelity when plan available) + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Round 1: 5 reviewers returned OK (Structure, Correctness, Edge-cases, Plan-fidelity, Codex-generic). 2 not substantive (Testing, Security — no provenance marker).

Accepted (4): normalize_exit_code_or_99 printf→larch_errf; lint exemption logic too broad; CHANGELOG 27.6.5 missing; test quiet-log hardening.
Rejected (4): heredoc helper nit; larch_err naming nit; mixed concerns nit; unplanned paths (normal workflow artifacts).

Round stopped after 1 round (non-substantial: no high-severity bugs, < 100 LOC applied, < 8 accepted).
